spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (ताडयति)
1 To beat, to strike.
2 To shine:
(इ) तडि r. 1st cl. (तण्डते)
To strike or beat.

m. (-डः)
1 Beating, whipping, inflicting bodily chastisement.
2 Sound, noise.
3 A handful of grass, corn, &c. a sheaf.
4 A mountain.
5 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
f. (-डि or डी)
A kind of palm, (Corypha talliera, Rox.) see ताली.
E.
तड to give pain, to beat, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-गः)
A pond, a tank: see तडाग.

m. (-गः)
1 A pond, a pool, deep enough for the growth of the lotus, &c. see the preceding.
2 A trap for catching deer, &c.
E.
तड to beat, affix आग, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A pond or pool, one deep enough for the lotus, &c.
f. (-का)
1 A bank, a shore.
2 A blow.
E.
तड to beat, Uṇādi affix आक; also तटाक and तडाग.

f. (-का)
A female demon, killed by RĀMA.

m. (-तः)
A blow from an elephant's uplifted trunk.
E.
तडा a beating, and आघात a blow.

m. (-तः)
An artificer who beats or hammers any thing.
E.
ताड, and घात a blow.

f. (-डित्)
Lightning.
E.
तड to strike or beat, Uṇādi affix इति; striking the earth, &c.

mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्)
Lightening, emitting lightning, flashing.
m. (-त्वान्)
A cloud.
E.
तडित्, lightning, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ता)
Forked lightning.
E.
तडित्, and लता a creeper.

n. (-लं)
Large cardamoms.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A kind of ear-ring: see तालपत्र.
E.
तड to shine, अङ्कन् affix; also ड being changed to ट, ताटङ्क.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Beating with a whip or with strokes of any kind.
E.
ताड, and घ who strikes.

n. (-नं)
Beating, whipping, &c.
f. (-नी)
A whip.
E.
तड to beat, अनीयुट् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be beaten, punishable.
E.
तड to beat, अनीयर् affix; also ताड्य and ताडयितव्य.

n. (-त्रं)
An ornament of the ear.
E.
ताड the Tāla tree, and पत्र a leaf, an earring resembling this: see तालपत्र.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what beats or strikes.
E.
तड to beat, तृच् aff.

ind.
Having beaten.
E.
तड to beat, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Struck, beaten.
E.
तड to beat, क्त aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Beating, who or what beats or strikes.
E.
तड to give pain, उलच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ड्यः-ड्या-ड्यं)
To be beaten or chastised, what may or ought to be punished, punishable.
E.
तड to beat, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being beaten or struck.
m. (-नः)
A musical instrument, which is struck, as a drum, &c.
E.
तड to beat or strike, शाणच् affix, यक् inserted.
